what_to_detect: A spell cast with an optional additional cost of tapping creatures of total power N or more, shown by the cost paid and the tapped creatures.
near_miss: The same kind of spell cast without declaring the optional additional cost.
record_fields: gen-3 card lines cast_with on the Teamwork keyword line of the spell on the stack
cost half payload.costs.tapped (the creatures tapped for the cost)
no family reads cast_with: resolution_outcome reads only the stack object's outcome, and a cost half holds no events for outcome_event

what_to_detect: A trigger on casting a spell using an optional additional cost fires when the cost was declared.
near_miss: The same kind of spell cast without declaring the optional additional cost.
record_fields: sidecar trigger line ValidSA$ Spell.Teamwork (Forge's spelling of 'cast using teamwork')
trigger_mode compares Mode$, Origin$, Destination$ and ValidCard$ only; Mode$ SpellCast alone matches every cast trigger
